title: The Energy Drink That Made a Man's Jaw Fall Off

sections.name: The Energy Drink That Made a Man's Jaw Fall Off
lines: In the 1920s, a wealthy American named Eben Byers drank a health drink every single day.
It was called Radithor. Distilled water, with radium dissolved in it.
Radioactive drinks were sold as a source of energy and youth. Byers drank around fourteen hundred bottles.
But radium acts a lot like calcium. Your body puts it in your bones, and it stays there, giving off radiation.
His bones began to break down. He lost most of his jaw. He died in 1932.
His death shocked America, and helped bring in stronger laws about what medicines could contain.
